description: Ends a connected app's sign-in at once: its tokens stop working and it has to be approved again. The API keys and webhook endpoints it created stay, and the answer counts them. Revoking it again returns its existing `revoked_at`.

app_id.description: The connected app's id (`oag_…`), from List connected apps.

name: mails_connected_apps_revoke
title: Revoke a connected app
